The '''NGW Hyperdrive Jump Program''' was a research program begun by [[Tumleh Navigation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. NGW stood for "Near [[Gravity well/Legends|Gravity Well]]". The program was an attempt to allow [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to jump in and out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in close proximity to [[Star/Legends|stars]] and [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. The program was extremely experimental, and what tests were performed only succeeded half the time.

The project data was stolen by Tumleh employee [[Zoam Urshant]] on orders of the [[G'uotr Network]], but her loyalty led her to turn the data over to the [[D'larah City Patrol]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lucius Flint]] of the DCP was a secret agent of the Network, however, and he ensured that they received a copy of the data. The destruction of [[Demophon]] in a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] brought an end to the program.<ref name="TC">{{WEGCite|story=Triple Cross|book=Supernova (sourcebook)}}</ref>
